w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Redactor, The Herald, The Reunion, The Focus Group, Big-Bane) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔️ Stephen stared down the Spool and it backed off — 1 round, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Agnese just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Rubble chokes the path.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Nora freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Rubble chokes the path.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Spoiler is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Peyton opens the pantry wide: 12× Foraged food, 1× Expedition haul. Chris, Agnese, Saiful, Nora and 1 more eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,584 kcal from the pantry) The channe
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Spoiler is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A voiceover that knows too much. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Static floods your senses — too much world, all at once. (-1 HP)
A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 4 tiles south-east caught a Cottontail Rabbit! About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

🌙 Watchers at the southeast treeline see torchlight moving in Stonebridge's camp — and it going dark. Whatever was coming, the doubled watch turned it. The night stays quiet, and everyone at the fire understands why.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Stonebridge in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 74 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 45 → 24 · capped · Craft 15 · Talk 16 · Explore 45 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Peyton Michalski walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — with every charge read aloud and answered, the ledger closed and clean. The village endures, and the record stands: what was hidden is hidden no more.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Peyton returns from the wilds hurt (health 2/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,241 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Apex Bow. The last thing the old world ever built right. It doesn't miss. Neither do you. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
